reason: Update() requires either a single JavaScript object or an alternating list of field/value pairs that can be followed by an optional precondition. Value for argument "dataOrField" is not a valid Firestore document. Couldn't serialize object of type "DeleteTransform" (found in field "field"). Firestore doesn't support JavaScript objects with custom prototypes (i.e. objects that were created via the "new" operator).
